answer: Rhythm-gated admission. Each identity must submit its first N transactions with inter-arrival gaps drawn from a secret schedule synchronized to a per-epoch quartz clock beacon; arrivals inside forbidden windows are dropped. The quill signs only schedules whose timing entropy exceeds a threshold, so clones arriving in bursts fail admission. Registrants post a vault deposit released only after 72 hours of compliant pacing. An attacker farming k identities pays k×72 hours of enforced idle wall-clock plus deposit lockup, making mass registration linearly expensive in time rather than money.
